name: react-native-bun-build
description: Ultra-fast custom bundler CLI for React Native bare projects powered by Bun

scripts.build: bun build packages/bundler-plugin/src/index.ts --outdir packages/bundler-plugin/dist --target node && bun build packages/cli/src/index.ts --outdir packages/cli/dist --target node && bun build packages/cli/src/commands/index.ts --outfile packages/cli/dist/commands/index.js --target node && bun build packages/cli/src/bin.ts --outfile packages/cli/dist/bin.js --target node
